FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KARACHCHI PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi, the recognized political party to whichSathasivam Ponnuththurai the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1)(a) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon the member of that No. 8 Wattakkachchi of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and isnot disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared elected as amember within a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Anthonippillai Sivakumaran to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Denicius Canute Aravintharaj, Returning Officer of the Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatAnthonippillai Sivakumaran was elected as the member of the No. 8 Wattakkachchi of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha.
D. C. ARAVINTHARAJ,Returning Officer,Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Kilinochchi,10th December, 2019.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE KARACHCHI PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi, the recognized political party to whichPirabamany Kanesamoorthy the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon returned member of that Ilankai Tamil Arasu Kadchi who belongs to such party and is not disqualifiedunder Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within aperiod of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Lalithakumari Saththiyamoorthi to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Denicius Canute Aravintharaj, Returning Officer of the Karachchi Pradeshsiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatLalithakumari Saththiyamoorthi was selected as the member of the Karachchi Pradeshsiya Sabha.
D. C. ARAVINTHARAJ,Returning Officer,Karachchi Pradeshiya Sabha.District Election Office,Kilinochchi,10th December, 2019.
